Arvest Trust Company decreased its stake in Walmart Inc (WMT) by 13.15% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Arvest Trust Company sold 19,938 shares as the company’s stock declined 11.45% with the market. The institutional investor held 131,635 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $11.71 million, down from 151,573 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Arvest Trust Company who had been investing in Walmart Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $248.21B market cap company.
